say: Shamfu, Shamfu mai Gyara Gashi da Kondishanar Gashi. Wannan shi ne babi na 3 na kwas ɗin.
Kayan gashi suna sayuwa ne ta yadda suke ji a hannu, don haka yau za mu yi duka uku mu gwada su a kan gashi na gaske.

shots.label: Shamfu don gashin Afirka
say: Gashin Afirka mai murɗewa yakan bushe, saboda man fatar kai ba ya bin murɗaɗɗen gashi cikin sauƙi.
Don haka shamfun da ke cikin waɗannan kwalabe ya kamata ya wanke fatar kai da kyau amma kada ya bushe gashi har ya yi ƙyas.
Idan aka kwatanta da sabulun hannu, muna ɗaga CAPB daga 5% zuwa 7% mu ƙara panthenol, wato provitamin B5, don ya taimaka gashi ya riƙe ruwa.

shots.label: Ƙananan sinadarai a ma'aunin 0.1 g

card.title: Shamfun Ifeoma na 12 kg
card.note: Mai aiki 11.9%. Da EDTA 12 g, preservative 96 g

say: Ifeoma a Owerri ta duba takardar mataimakiyarta kafin haɗinta na farko na kilogiram 12.
Layukan da ba ruwa ba sun kai giram 3,084, don haka ruwa dole ya zama giram 8,916. Ya yi daidai.
Ki lura da panthenol da ake ɗorawa a ƙaramin ma'auni. Ƙananan adadi suna buƙatar ma'auni mai cikakken daidaito, ba babba ba.

shots.label: Ruwa da EDTA, sannan SLES
say: A cikin bokitin, ki narkar da EDTA a ruwa, ki ajiye kusan 10% don ruwan gishiri.
Ki narkar da SLES a hankali kina juyawa sannu-sannu, sannan ki ƙara CAPB, gilisarin da panthenol.
Ki fara haɗa turaren da ɗan CAPB, ki zuba shi tare da preservative.

shots.label: pH da ake so 5 zuwa 6
say: Yanzu takardar gwaji. Shamfu ya kamata ya ɗan yi tsami, kusan 5 zuwa 6. Ki daidaita ta hanyar samfur 1% daga babi na 1.

shots.label: Ruwan gishiri bayan gwajin mataki
say: Ki ƙara kauri da ruwan gishiri bayan gwajin mataki-mataki, ya ɗan fi sabulun hannunki kauri. Sannan ki bar shi ya kwana, ki duba shi kafin ki cika kwalabe.

shots.label: Ki wanke ido da ruwa mai tsabta
say: Yawancin shamfu suna ƙona ido. Rubutunki dole ya ce: a guji shiga ido, kuma idan ya shiga, a wanke sosai da ruwa mai tsabta, kamar haka.
Kada ki rubuta ba ya ƙona ido, yana maganin amosanin kai, ko yana tsawaita gashi sai kina da gwaji da amincewar NAFDAC.

shots.label: Ruwan guar a cikin ruwan da ake juyawa

card.title: Shamfu 2-cikin-1 na Kemi, 10 kg
rows: Ruwa, an ɗan sa masa tsami
A juya har ya yi santsi

say: Don shamfu 2-cikin-1, ɗan sinadarin cationic polymer kaɗan yana barin siririn shafi a kan gashi idan kika kurkura.
Garin yana dunƙulewa idan kin zuba shi kai tsaye. Don haka Kemi ta juya guar ɗinta giram 30 cikin gilisarin tukuna, sannan ta zuba kwaɓin cikin ruwan da ake juyawa.
Bayan minti 30, da ya yi santsi ya ɗan yi kauri, ta ci gaba da hanyar shamfu ta yau da kullum.

shots.label: Na yau da kullum da 2-cikin-1

card.title: Gwajin taje gashi a jike
card.note: Misalin kwas; a maimaita kwana uku a ɗauki matsakaici

say: Ki tabbatar yana aiki. Ki wanke gashi guda biyu iri ɗaya, kowanne da kwalba ɗaya, sannan ki ƙirga tajin matsefi lokacin da yake a jike.
Kada ki taɓa yin 2-cikin-1 ta zuba kondishana ko maganin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta na quat cikin shamfu. Zai yi dushi ya rabu.

shots.label: Ki fara auna tukunyar ba komai

card.title: Kondishana mai kauri, 5 kg
rows: B: Man kaɗe da aka tace

say: Yanzu kondishana, wato kirim da ba ya kumfa. Ki auna kashi A a tukunyar ƙarfe, kuma ki fara rubuta nauyin tukunyar ba komai.
Kashi B, wato kakin, yana shiga tukunya ta biyu. Ƙwayoyin BTMS-50 suna haɗa mai da ruwa, suna kuma gyara gashi.

shots.label: Riga mai dogon hannu, safar zafi
shots.banner: Ki narkar da kaki a ruwan zafi, ba a kan wuta ba
say: Narkakken kaki a digiri 75 yana jawo mummunar ƙuna kuma yana manne wa fata.
Ki saka riga mai dogon hannu, takalmi rufaffe da safar hannu mai jure zafi. Ki juya hannun tukunya ciki, kada ki bar yara su shigo.

shots.label: Ana zuba kashi B cikin kashi A
say: Ana dumama tukwanen biyu a cikin ruwan zafi zuwa kusan digiri 75. Ki riƙe su minti 10 zuwa 15 don dukan kakin ya narke.
Ki kalla: kashi B yana shiga kashi A, ana markaɗawa da blenda ɗan lokaci-ɗan lokaci na minti 2 zuwa 3.
Ki ci gaba da juyawa yayin da yake hucewa. Kin ga yana yin kauri kamar kirim tsakanin kusan digiri 50 da 40.

shots.label: Kashi C: preservative, turare
shots.banner: Ƙasa da digiri 40: ki zuba kashi C
say: Sai ƙasa da digiri 40 ne kawai ake zuba preservative da turare. Zafi yana lalata su.

shots.label: Ruwan sanyi mai gudu don ƙuna
say: Idan kaki mai zafi ya taɓa fata, ki sanyaya ƙunar a ƙarƙashin ruwan sanyi mai gudu na aƙalla minti 20, ki je asibiti idan ƙunar ta fi ɗan wuri kaɗan girma.

card.title: Gwajin ruwan da ya ɓace na Ngozi

say: Mu koma kan ma'auni. Tukunyar Ngozi ba komai giram 1,800 ce, don haka da kirim kilogiram 5 ya kamata ya nuna giram 6,800. Ya nuna giram 6,640.
Ta mayar da giram 160 na ruwan da aka tafasa aka sanyaya, ta juya. Ki bar shi awa 24, ki duba pH yana kusan 4 zuwa 5.5, sannan ki cika tuluna masu faɗin baki.
Yanzu ki bi darussan da ke ƙasa. Ki yi shamfun gwajinki da ƙungiyar masu gwadawa, kwatancen 2-cikin-1 naki, da kondishanarki ta farko ta kilogiram 1 tare da rubutun zafin wuta.
